What I established and on what evidence: (1) All seven WZO1 artifacts run under the current battery; recorded values + denominators + SHAs + binary stamps in the committed baseline; every value re-derived by the gate's fresh-binary run (fast path reproduces all 4x3-and-under cells exactly). (2) v1 4x4 I2 fail 11,658,047/24,318,165 matches 4x4.V1-INVSYM-BROKEN (T260) exactly — register reproduction is the golden-master ideal. (3) I7 failures on PSK artifacts are predicate mismatches (no-placement vs passes==2 termination) — verified by replicating the battery's terminal predicate in Python: the flagged slots are exactly the no-placement states with DTT=255. (4) All three 4x4 artifacts have DTT uniformly 255 (raw column scan) — the checkpoints share v1's DTT-unset signature, which pass1 spec §7 documents for v1 only. (5) 0c3366f0 passes every WZO2 acceptance check (A1-A9) — structurally complete at group granularity (no zero-entry groups, cumulative counts match header); stride 97 coprime to all group sizes {2,4,5,6,7,8}. (6) Parallel checkpoint fails I6: 24,312,854 stored-legal vs 24,318,165 header — 5,311 deficit.

What I could not establish: (a) Whether the battery's I7/I9 cells at 4x4 should be implemented by T292 — out of scope (battery code is T168-T187's); recorded as battery gaps F4/F2/F3. (b) The root cause of the parallel checkpoint's 5,311-position deficit — beyond baseline recording; the register already distrusts these artifacts. (c) Whether oracle-v2-accept's stdout corruption (F6) is a util.out buffering bug or a Zig 0.16 writer issue — observed, worked around, not fixed (out of scope). (d) Whether the 131,068 size-2 WZO2 groups are related to T266's 131,068 absent-passes=1 count — numeric coincidence noted, not resolved.

Assumptions I made without checking: the battery's I5 graph at 4x3 (544MB peak) is within the runner budget (it is — 4096MB cap); the 'failed command:' suite echoes are the T289-documented zig 0.16 quirk (reconfirmed exit 0). Noticed but did not act on: (i) harness exit codes disagree with T290 spec §6 (2/3 swapped, no measurement-only mode) — F8, left for the battery owner; (ii) the harness never fills the error field for status=error results (only emitError does) — cosmetic, the JSONL records status/exit_class which is what the gate compares; (iii) I5 is per-goban per the matrix but the harness runs it per-artifact (its denominator — ko_sensitive_flags — is artifact-dependent), so the baseline records it per artifact; (iv) the 2x2 PSK root is +1 (not 0), which is itself a ruleset-dependence datum worth a future register row — not claimed here since PSK fresh-start values are outside my scope.
